g.text: Study 6 — Reorganization is a topic-transition phenomenon, legible in the meeting's real agenda

Figure 6. (A) In ±30 s of a topic-episode boundary, team-state entropy rises and %DET falls vs episode interiors — topic transitions are the naturalistic perturbation that drives reorganization (non-circular: boundaries are lexical,

metrics are turn-taking). (B) On the EOS Level 10 agenda these teams run, the procedural review stages reorganize more than the problem-solving (IDS) block — reorganization is coordination, not deliberation. Paired Wilcoxon;
